question_text: The Earth revolves around the Sun because of the gravitational pull between the two celestial bodies.
explanation: Gravitational pull is the scientific reason for orbital motion.

question_text: Drinking large amounts of sea water is the safest and most effective way to stay hydrated while lost in a desert.
explanation: Sea water is saline and causes dehydration; it is absurd to use it for hydration.

question_text: We wear seatbelts while driving in cars because:-
options: They keep our clothes from getting wrinkled
They prevent our bodies from moving forward due to inertia during a sudden stop
They are required to keep the engine running
explanation: Seatbelts counteract inertia during sudden deceleration.

question_text: Modern airplanes have rounded windows instead of square ones because:-
options: Square windows create stress corners that can crack under high cabin pressure
Rounded windows act as magnifying glasses
explanation: Pressure distribution is more uniform in rounded openings.

question_text: Write the LAST letter of the rearranged sentence: away doctor the keeps day a apple an
explanation: An apple a day keeps the doctor away. Last letter is Y.

question_text: Write the LAST letter of the rearranged sentence: never late better than
explanation: Better late than never. Last letter is R.
